observed.cause: the same PROMUSDT/TACUSDT trend candidates were repeatedly entered and emergency-closed after the legacy conditional-order endpoint returned Binance -4120

counterfactual_policy.candidate_semantics: at-most-once; one PROMUSDT long and one TACUSDT long

primary_replay.model: one-minute bars; trailing extreme sampled from closes; conservative relative to intraminute high

intraminute_sensitivity.description: if the TAC trailing extreme followed the one-minute high before the next-minute pullback

data_quality.PROMUSDT: Binance public spot aggregate trades and one-minute bars; futures basis is not represented
data_quality.TACUSDT: Gate USDT perpetual one-minute proxy because Binance Futures public history was unreachable from the analysis environment
data_quality.classification: counterfactual incident replay, not an exchange-exact tick backtest
